newsitem.title: USA: Aetna, FPA Medical in provider pact.
newsitem.headline: Aetna, FPA Medical in provider pact.

text.p: Aetna U.S. Healthcare Inc and FPA Medical Management Inc said Monday they signed a national, long-term agreement that will allow many Aetna U.S. Healthcare members to use FPA-affiliated physicians.

The companies said the non-exclusive, relationship is effective July 1 and will initially involve physicians and patients in Arizona, California, Texas, Louisiana, Missouri, Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Delaware, New Jersey and Pennsylvania.
FPA, a national physician practice management company, said it expects to expand its network into the New York marketplace in the near future.

Aetna U.S. Healthcare, the health business unit of Aetna Inc, has a total health care enrollment of more than 14 million members nationwide. FPA said it currently provides medical care through its network to about 7,000 Aetna members in California.
